text: It is essential for humans to use the personal pronoun. It divides the universe into two parts. The darkness behind the eyes, where the little voice is, and everything else.
author: Terry Pratchett
visual_brief: An architectural section drawing of a solitary camera obscura set on an infinite flat plane, showing a tiny pinhole aperture admitting a single thread of light into a sealed, pitch-black interior chamber. Fine dashed projection lines trace the stark division between the vast external grid and the hollow space within.
alt: Architectural section drawing of a camera obscura dividing inner and outer space
